name: Datte Petdamon!
source:
Following the little girl around her room, to the bathroom, the kitchen. Pouting, getting angry, being spoiled -- this game allows you to spend the day with your very own pet!

Those in the know should get the inside jokes, but I'm begging you NOT to go asking me to clue you in.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ036251.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
跟着小女孩绕过她的房间，到了浴室、厨房。噘嘴、生气、被宠坏——这个游戏让你可以和你自己的宠物一起度过一天！

知情者应该知道里面的笑话，但我恳求你不要让我给你提供线索。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ036251.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
